sentences.text: Hello, everyone.
Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slow and easy English.
Today, we talk about a very small and remote place.
The place is Colusa.
Colusa is in Greenland.
Greenland is a large island in the Arctic.
Colusa is a small village near the ocean.
It is quiet and very cold.
Part two, only a few hundred people live in Colusa.
Everyone knows each other.
Life is simple and calm.
People live close to nature.
Part three, Colusa is surrounded by mountains, snow and ice.
The landscape is white and blue.
The sea is full of ice in many months.
It is a very beautiful place.
Part four, the weather in Colusa is very cold.
Winter is long and dark.
Temperatures are often below zero.
People wear very warm clothes every day.
Part five, in summer, the weather becomes a little warmer.
Snow starts to melt.
The days become very long.
Sometimes the sun shines all night.
Part six, fishing is very important in Colusa.
Many people catch fish from the sea.
Fishing is a main job in the village.
People eat fresh fish very often.
Part seven, hunting is also part of traditional life.
People hunt animals for food and clothing.
This is an old tradition in the Arctic.
It is important for survival.
Part eight, dogs are very important in Colusa.
Many people have sled dogs.
In winter, dogs pull sleds on the snow.
This is a traditional way of travel.
Part nine, the people in Colusa are friendly and strong.
They live in a hard climate but stay positive.
Community is very important.
People help each other.
Part 10, visitors can see amazing nature in Colusa.
There are icebergs, mountains and the ocean.
Some people come to see the northern lights.
Others come to enjoy the quiet life.
Part 11, transportation in Colusuk is limited.
There are no big roads.
People travel by boat, helicopter or on foot.
Life is very different from big cities.
Part 12, Colusuk is a small and peaceful place.
The cold weather, simple life and beautiful nature
make it unique.
Visitors can experience a different way of living.
Even though it is far away,
Colusuk is a very special place.
